patterns.note: Full-bleed sections with alternating background colors define distinct content blocks, creating strong visual separation.
Primary headings utilize an extremely bold, blocky, and geometric custom display typeface for maximum impact.
Large section titles are rendered with an outline effect, allowing the background color to show through the text for a unique visual texture.
A high-contrast palette of dark charcoal, light taupe, and vibrant accent colors (orange, green, blue) creates a dynamic and modern aesthetic.
The page background color smoothly transitions between dark charcoal and light taupe as the user scrolls between major sections.
The top-left logo, top-right contact information, and menu icon remain sticky at the top of the viewport throughout the scroll.
The hero section features a dynamic, abstract 3D object rendered via a canvas animation, providing a captivating visual focal point.
Content sections are often dominated by a single, oversized typographic statement or a central, interactive visual element like stacked cards.

technique_notes: Implement a scroll-triggered background color transition for full-bleed sections, smoothly animating between a dark charcoal and a light taupe as sections enter the viewport.
Utilize a sticky header containing the brand logo, contact link, and navigation toggle, ensuring it remains visible and accessible throughout the scroll.
Create a dynamic hero visual using a canvas-based animation to render an abstract, iridescent 3D object that provides a captivating focal point.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, blocky display headings (~5-8x body) with small, clean sans-serif for utility and body text.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (predominantly rectangular forms, with subtle rounding on interactive elements like the stacked cards/tickets).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (significant vertical spacing between full-bleed sections, creating distinct visual breaks, but elements within sections can be dense, like the stacked cards).

standout: The site's most distinctive feature is its bold, almost brutalist typography, using a custom, blocky geometric font for all major headings, often with an outline effect. This, combined with the dramatic full-page background color transitions on scroll and the abstract 3D canvas animation in the hero, creates an aggressively modern and highly memorable brand identity that feels more like a digital art installation than a typical agency website.
